response.sql: WITH invoice_ratios AS (SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count, 1.0 * SUM(derived_product_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_cost_ratio FROM invoice_ratios), results AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, i.cost_ratio, i.line_item_count, i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_cost_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_ratios AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT invoice_number, cost_ratio, line_item_count, relative_ratio FROM results ORDER BY CASE WHEN relative_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A ratio with a zero or missing denominator is NULL; a zero overall average exists, but makes relative ratios NULL.
